derived_no_calibration_source.literal: no calibration / trim / OTP-cal source in input
derived_no_calibration_source.label: L12 no_calibration auto-set (#634 facet e) — absence-based, mirrors L5.no_analog

typical_master_transmit_sequence: 1. Software writes SPICR1 to set SPE=1, MSTR=1 + desired {CPOL, CPHA, LSBFE, SSOE, SPIE, SPTIE}.
2. Software writes SPICR2 to set MODFEN / SPC0 / BIDIROE / SPISWAI as needed.
3. Software writes SPIBR (SPPR, SPR) to set baud rate divisor.
4. Read SPISR; SPTEF=1 indicates SPIDR ready to accept TX data.
5. Software writes TX byte to SPIDR.
7. 16 SCK edges complete the transfer (8 sample + 8 shift); SPIF set on 16th edge.
8. Software reads SPISR (with SPIF=1) then SPIDR to retrieve RX byte and clear SPIF.
typical_slave_receive_sequence: 1. Software writes SPICR1 to set SPE=1, MSTR=0 + desired {CPOL, CPHA, LSBFE}.
2. Software writes SPIDR with byte to drive on MISO (or accepts default of zeros).
4. Master toggles 16 SCK edges; slave shifts in/out one byte simultaneously.
5. After 16th edge (CPHA=0) or one half SCK after last edge (CPHA=1), SPIF is set in slave's SPISR.
6. Software reads SPISR (with SPIF=1) then SPIDR to retrieve RX byte and clear SPIF.
reception_with_spif_serviced_in_time: If SPIF is set and a valid byte is in the receive shift register, and SPIF is serviced before the start of a third transmission, the byte in the receive shift register is transferred into the SPIDR and SPIF remains set (Figure 3-6).
reception_with_spif_serviced_too_late: If SPIF is set and a valid byte is in the receive shift register, and SPIF is serviced after the start of a third transmission, the byte in the receive shift register is lost and is not transferred into the SPIDR (Figure 3-7).
mode_fault_recovery_sequence: 1. Master detects SS LOW with MODFEN=1.
2. MODF set; MSTR cleared (auto-switched to slave); SCK/MOSI/MISO outputs disabled; any in-progress transmission aborted.
3. Software reads SPISR (with MODF=1) then writes SPICR1 to clear MODF and reconfigure as master or slave.
low_power_mode_entry: On entering wait/stop mode with SPISWAI=1, master aborts in-progress transmission; slave keeps shifting if master still drives SCK (continues to track master).
